body:
Ported PARENA's shell_quote_single + current-file/board-profile-aware compile_and_upload_avr onto EDITOR.GAME's own widget-refactored editor_main.c (the two forks had diverged: EDITOR.GAME had the embeddable widget API, PARENA had the AVR fix, neither had both). Delegates the actual AVR toolchain invocation to a sibling ../PARENA checkout (make -C ../PARENA, same convention as make regenerate) since EDITOR.GAME carries no examples/avr/ tree of its own. Live-verified headless (Xvfb, EDITOR_WIDGET_TEST_BUILD): injected a real Upload-button click on a non-PARENA-tree .prn file, confirmed it drove the real parena build -> avr-gcc -> avr-objcopy -> avrdude chain against the correct file, failing only at avrdude's port-open step (no physical board in this sandbox). make -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror clean. Commit EDITOR.GAME@0f7bca5, pushed. Closes the Phase 2 prerequisite named in EDGE.GAME/NORTHSTAR.md.

⚓ ☃
title: Merge widget-lifecycle fork with PARENA's current-file-aware AVR upload fix
